bounded_hypothesis: Current OmD should provide a machine-checkable actionable workflow after install and doctor where the exact v1.9.0 release required an external documentation or agent-inference step.
decision: Current closes the local structured-routing activation gap. Baseline time and step count are right-censored because the route command does not exist; do not claim a speed ratio.
first_failure_rule: Any install failure, candidate route failure, ambiguous candidate route, hidden human step, or provider call fails the comparison.
claim_boundary: This compares CLI capability and local orchestration only. It does not compare generated UI quality, human comprehension, retention, or model performance.
